summary: Pac-Man entries from Sami's spine and the prepared candidate backlog, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Pac-Man Vs.

emulation.emulator: Nintendo Switch hardware; Dolphin only for original GameCube hardware-chain preservation
emulation.notes: Use Switch for practical multiplayer. Use GameCube/Dolphin plus GBA-link setup only if documenting the original interface.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Modern Switch remake/reissue for active play; original GameCube route for hardware-authentic archival comparison.

primary.why: With no Sami platform specified, the Nintendo Switch Namco Museum release is the best main route: it is an official modern remake/reissue, avoids the GameCube-to-GBA hardware chain, and supports the intended asymmetric multiplayer with two Switch systems.
primary.how_to_play: Play Pac-Man Vs. through Namco Museum on Nintendo Switch. For multiplayer, use two Switch systems as intended; use the single-console ghost mode only as a fallback or quick sample.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Switch version still needs two Switch systems for the intended four-player setup; Pac-Man Museum+ does not list Pac-Man Vs. among its included games on the official page.

entries.title: Pac-Man

emulation.notes: Use original display ratio/settings where possible.

primary.why: Arcade Archives PAC-MAN is a modern official release of Namco's 1980 arcade game with arcade-display settings, making it the cleanest sourced route for the original maze game without substituting a later remix.
primary.how_to_play: Play Arcade Archives PAC-MAN on Switch or PS4/PS5 compatibility, preserve the original aspect ratio/display options, and use PAC-MAN MUSEUM+ only when sampling the wider series collection.

entries.remaster_caveats: PAC-MAN MUSEUM+ is useful for the wider franchise but adds collection progression/wrapper systems; it is not the cleanest standalone route for the 1980 arcade entry.

entries.title: Ms. Pac-Man
entries.definitive_edition: Original arcade version via cabinet/PCB or owned licensed legacy compilation

emulation.emulator: MAME only as a documented preservation route
emulation.notes: Prefer original hardware or owned licensed release; document ROM/source and legal availability caveats.

primary.platform: Arcade cabinet / owned legacy compilation / preservation route
primary.why: Ms. Pac-Man is a distinct arcade maze game and should not be merged with Pac-Man. Modern official availability is complicated by rights and character-use changes, so the clean archive target is the original arcade version via cabinet/PCB or an owned legacy licensed release, with exact release/source documented.
primary.how_to_play: Use an original arcade cabinet/PCB or an owned licensed compilation/release that preserves Ms. Pac-Man. Record hardware or compilation, ROM/version, DIP/settings, display, controls, maze set, scoring target, and any legal/availability caveats. Use MAME only as a preservation route when ownership/source is documented.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting a specific port.
secondary.why: The arcade game is the primary historical artifact.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record exact source/release and avoid substituting Pac-Mom/Pac-Man Museum+ replacements for Ms. Pac-Man.
